scope: Audit of actual compiled course locomotion models and bounded simulated trained-policy rollouts. No hardware was used; defaults and running training jobs were preserved.

findings.finding: Original walking model intentionally uses four foot and four knee spheres; visual torso and leg meshes do not contribute collision response.
findings.evidence: locomotion-contact-audit.json: all six compiled task records
findings.implication: This is a course model simplification, separate from the confirmed tracking-hull masking regression.

findings.finding: MixedGaits-Bumpy and Mystery-Bumpy each compile 200 nonflat heightfields with maximum height span 0.04999184952 m; forced C and Warp contact probes see ground contact.
findings.implication: Rough terrain is physically active. Contact positions in forced overlap probes are not terrain-height measurements or rollout success.

findings.finding: Default knee contact sensor has history_length=0; self_collision_cost falls back to found-contact count, so force_threshold does not gate this reward.
findings.evidence: Actual forced probes produce the same cost for thresholds 1 N and 1000000 N; tasks/velocity/mdp/rewards.py self_collision_cost
findings.implication: Interpret as binary knee-contact cost, not force-threshold cost. Behavior is unchanged because this fallback may be intentional.

findings.finding: Mystery torso_clearance uses rotated torso AABB versus world z=0; it does not query local heightfield surface.
findings.evidence: tasks/pupper_gait/mdp/jump.py torso_clearance; default Mystery weight 0; optional2 experiment explicitly sets -20
findings.implication: A soft world-height penalty does not add physical body collision and cannot support a rough-terrain body-clearance claim.

findings.finding: Root world-height metrics and base_height objectives are not terrain-relative clearance. Direct mesh-heightfield distance did not validate for this model.
findings.evidence: pupper/mdp/rewards.py base_height; pupper_gait/bootstrap.py names measured heights *_world_m; collision_audit.py refuses heightfields
findings.implication: Current signed clearance screen is intentionally plane-only. Do not use it to certify Bumpy or Mystery-Bumpy torso safety.

findings.finding: Trained SpiderWalk has zero falls but penetrates torso geometry in 75.72% of scored states, including every scored stationary state; max penetration 32.73 mm.
findings.evidence: locomotion-geometry-screen.json: SpiderWalk model_3999.pt, seed 101, 4 worlds, 18 commands, 6 seconds per command, 1 second warmup, deployment target clamp
findings.implication: Do not install this checkpoint. Absence of falls is insufficient; correction and retraining are justified by observed behavior.

findings.finding: Stable and Mixed checkpoints have no torso penetration in this same type of screen; minimum clearances 58.08 mm and 71.49 mm respectively.
findings.evidence: locomotion-geometry-screen.json: 22000 Stable and 16000 Mixed scored states
findings.implication: Continue existing foot/knee-only controlled comparisons. This single-seed bounded screen is not hardware approval or exhaustive robustness validation.

correction_experiment.scope: One zero-density torso hull, capped at 32 vertices, with tracking-compatible masks 0/1. Original masses, inertias and eight sphere shapes/masks retained. No lower-leg hulls. Torso can contact terrain and nonadjacent active knee/foot spheres.
correction_experiment.evidence: test_locomotion_torso_contact.py verifies exact mass/inertia equality, sphere equality, nine compiled active geoms, real C/Warp floor contacts and nonzero force in an isolated forced probe.
correction_experiment.decision: Evaluate unchanged SpiderWalk checkpoint under corrected contact first, then warm-start the exact original reward profile with explicit torso contact, target clamp and composed COM randomization.

paired_existing_policy_result.interpretation: Deep nonphysical overlap is prevented, with residual soft-contact penetration and possible body support. This is not a torso-clearance success or an installation recommendation. Continue exact original reward profile under all three corrected contracts; evaluate body clearance and tracking again.

training_smoke.claim: Infrastructure validation only; not an improvement measurement.

validation.tests: 16 passed: collision audit (3), torso-contact model (2), bootstrap (11)
validation.method: Actual compiled Pupper mesh signed plane distance agrees with lowest transformed mesh vertex at upright and rotated poses to 1e-8 m.
limitations: Four worlds and correlated trajectory steps at one seed are a screening experiment, not independent reliability trials.
Compiled mesh dimensions are not independently verified against this physical robot.
Diagnostic samples precede policy transitions; between-step contacts or a final failing state can be missed.
